clips.title: The story
paras: On Stone Cairn Lake’s central island, Heroes' Vigil lies neglected and overrun by renegade wizards. Its Stone of Remembrance honors those who fell in the First War.

Heroes' Vigil stands on an island in Stone Cairn Lake, centered on the Stone of Remembrance. Erected after the First War, its inscribed stone circle honors the soldiers and citizens slaughtered when the Old Horde sacked Goldshire and the surrounding valleys. Once revered as a sacred place of faith and sacrifice, the vigil has slipped from Stormwind's attention. Its grounds now lie overgrown, with no soldiers sent to tend them.

With no kingdom garrison on the island, outcasts have taken the memorial. Rogue wizards control Stone Cairn Lake and the grounds, practicing wild, undisciplined magic beyond the oversight of the Kirin Tor and the Academy of Arcane Sciences. Near the stones lies Henze Faulk's body among other tragic casualties. Travelers can only wonder whether the shrine will ever know peace again.
